description: This PHP source file defines an abstract controller class 'AbstractInstallerVueController' used as part of an installer and upgrader system for the OrangeHRM HR management software. It sets up rendering with Twig templates, manages the sequence of installer/upgrader steps, and provides base functionality for specific installer controller implementations.

classes.name: AbstractInstallerVueController
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionalities for installer and upgrader Vue controllers, including rendering templates, managing steps, and context setup.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Returns the Twig Environment instance used for rendering templates.

methods.name: setTemplate
methods.description: Sets the template filename for rendering.

methods.name: setComponent
methods.description: Associates a Vue component with this controller.

methods.name: getContext
methods.description: Returns the AttributeBag used for template context variables.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initialization hook intended to be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Hook before rendering the template, can be overridden by subclasses.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the specified template with context variables.

methods.name: postRender
methods.description: Post-render hook for subclasses to implement additional behavior.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main execution method that manages pre-render, render, and post-render steps, returning a response.

methods.name: getContextParams
methods.description: Prepares and returns an array of context parameters for rendering.

methods.name: getAssetsVersion
methods.description: Returns a version string or timestamp for assets, used for cache busting.

methods.name: getSteps
methods.description: Determines the sequence of installation or upgrade steps based on current state.

methods.name: getCurrentStep
methods.description: Calculates and returns the current step index based on the state.
